summary: Compact audit snapshot export with entity map and translation glossary for legal/evidence review
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests an on-demand compact audit snapshot (single-day delta) with an accompanying entity resolution map and a field translation glossary. Purpose is to provide legal and internal audit teams a human-readable bundle that links Redwood audit event IDs to the customer's internal IDs and field names.

Background: Northern Trustline is preparing a regulatory evidence packet for a European inflow review. They need a lightweight (compressed) snapshot for 2026-02-28 to hand off to their legal counsel. They’ve previously received full deltas but require a compact format with explicit entity joins and a glossary mapping Redwood field names to their canonical schema.

Requested export constraints: compact (gzipped newline-delimited JSON or parquet with minimal columns), chronological ordering, per-record envelope with HMAC of event_id and resume-token for integrity, timezone-normalized timestamps (UTC and customer local time), and an entity_map.csv that lists event_id -> customer_user_id / tenant_user_id / session_id joins. Also require a translation_glossary.csv that maps Redwood audit field names to the customer’s schema and short descriptions for each field for legal reviewers.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer requests snapshot for date 2026-02-28 via support channel.
2) Support validates tenant ID and authorization scope.
3) Request export job created against prod-us-east archival index with filters: tenant_id=<customer_tenant>, date range 2026-02-28 00:00:00 to 2026-02-28 23:59:59 UTC, minimal fields: event_id, timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, metadata.hash, resume_token.
4) Export tooling to generate compact NDJSON -> gzip and generate entity_map.csv by joining actor_id/resource_id to known identity resolution table.
5) Wrap records in per-batch signed manifest (HMAC-SHA256) and stage to SFTP destination with one-time presigned credentials.

Expected outcome: Customer receives a single compressed bundle plus CSV mappings and a small README describing canonicalization rules and glossary definitions.
logs_and_observations: Export jobs attempted against archival index returned full snapshot earlier this week; previous export included extra debug fields that legal flagged as confusing. Support run on 2026-03-09 produced a 4.8GB export; customer requested a ~200MB compact bundle. No SFTP delivery has been completed yet for this tenant in prod-us-east. No 5xx errors seen in job run logs; minor warnings for unknown actor_id mapping (approx 0.6% of records).
